Ahmad al-Alshaikh, executive vice president for aluminium at Maaden, said Saudi Arabia's hosting of major expositions, as well as the football World Cup in 2034, which will involve building 15 new stadiums, was driving demand.
Saudi aluminium demand is set to reach 1.6 million to 1.8 million tons by 2030, al-Alshaikh said on the sidelines of the Fastmarkets International Aluminium Conference in Budapest.
Maaden produces around 780,000 tons per year of primary aluminium and around 1 million tons of cast metal.
Of this 85%, is sold on the domestic market.
